_comment: Node 2 payment-notice scenarios for Peel Acupuncture. Written 2026-09-15 to cover commit 553ca0f8's PAYMENT NOTICE addition on the new-patient Initial Consultation + Acupuncture Treatment (348590) and existing-patient Extended Appointment (348510) branches.

scenarios.name: New patient hits the deposit notice verbatim with zero tool call

history.content: I'd like to book in for acupuncture.
Have you had Acupuncture with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks the $55 deposit notice verbatim word-for-word (including the 2-hour window and auto-cancellation line) as the entire turn, with zero tool call and no filler phrase before or after it. FAIL if it calls confirm_service this turn, shortens/paraphrases the notice, or adds any other spoken content.

scenarios.name: Caller acknowledgement after the deposit notice resumes booking without repeating it

history.content: I'd like to book in for acupuncture.
Have you had Acupuncture with us before?

Just so you know, this appointment requires a $55 deposit to secure the booking. I'll send you a secure link to pay it after we book -- please complete it within 2 hours, as unpaid bookings are automatically cancelled after that time. Shall I go ahead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='348590', appointment_type='Initial Consultation + Acupuncture Treatment', variant_type='initial', patient_status='new'. FAIL if it repeats or references the deposit notice again in any form, or omits the tool call.

scenarios.name: Returning-patient Standard (no deposit) branch stays a normal filler-then-tool turn

history.content: I'd like to book acupuncture, I've been before.
Would you like the Standard 35 minute or Extended 45 minute appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='348509' in the same turn, with zero deposit/payment language. FAIL if it speaks any payment/deposit notice for this branch — the notice is scoped only to appointment types 348590 and 348510.
